svg.title: MDS01 video pipeline and encryption
svg.text: A · Combined VEEG reference clip: playback and EEG sync only, no model
B · Standalone analysis clip: VSViG seizure scoring (one job at a time)
C · Facial expression: independent lane, starts at upload, runs alongside B

text.tspan: decrypt a temporary copy → read clock
make an audio-free H.264 copy once
decrypt to emotion-work/ → find the face
— every video, score and emotion request checks the owner, decrypts on demand, and returns a private, no-store response. Raw names, file paths and keys are never returned.
